changes: Adds phone-friendly passkey enrollment for an exact trusted Discord teammate through the sealed owner-gate runtime.
Routes sensitive-report authorization and its result back to the exact originating Discord thread.
Installs two-way, create-only public trust anchors with exact Ed25519 identity verification.
Keeps enrollment single-use and separate from report approval, so enrollment alone authorizes no operation.
known_limitations: The flow is usable only after the exact owner-gate package and both public trust anchors are deployed and verified.
Expired, failed, or pre-release invitations cannot be repaired or reused; the operator must issue a fresh invitation after production smoke.
